title: Create two objects
explanation: Each new expression creates a distinct StudyCard, even though both topics are Objects. Each instance starts with its own reviewCount of zero.

title: Review the first object
explanation: first.review() changes Object A. Object B is a separate instance and stays unchanged.

title: Add an alias and review again
explanation: alias = first copies the reference, not the object. alias.review() changes Object A again. There are still two objects, not three.
